title: Local equality criterion for concrete frame classes
statement: In the precise setting of [def-pur-frame-class], let two length-c tuples f,g on the same etale U over V present the scheme-theoretic inverse image of the same smooth closed Z over B with pointwise Krull codimension c. Assume that for every x in U there is an open neighbourhood W on which their restricted concrete boundary products are heterogeneously equal. Then their global concrete frame classes, canonically transported by frameClosedCoefficientIso to support on the fixed pullback Z times_V U, are equal. The local equality hypothesis is an equality of the actual restricted boundary products, and no assertion of generator invariance is part of this criterion.

proof.text: Choose an open neighbourhood at each point from the hypothesis, giving a Zariski, hence etale, cover. Kummer boundary pullback, cup pullback and their comparison identify the restrictions of each concrete global class with the local boundary product. The two support comparison isomorphisms are the canonical ones over the monic closed immersion; constant pullback and direct-image composition identify their coefficient maps. Thus the hypothesis gives equality of the restrictions in a common supported Hom group.

Use the supported Hom model and the finite coefficient comparison, forgetting scalar action, to view the classes as degree-2c support cohomology classes with twist c. Apply relative_support_bottom_descent with d=P.level, r=c, the original frame f, and the chosen cover. Its separation assertion identifies the global classes. The Hom and site-comparison maps are bijections, so the original global representatives agree. For c=0 use degree-zero separation, and the empty scheme permits the empty cover.

theorem frameClass_eq_of_locally_heq (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {B V Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (v : V ⟶ B)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension P.level v] (i : Z ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [Smooth (i ≫ v)] (c : ℕ)
    (hcodim : ∀ z : Z, ringKrullDim (V.presheaf.stalk (i z)) =
      ringKrullDim (Z.presheaf.stalk z) + (c : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : U ⟶ V) [Etale e] (f g : Fin c → Γ(U, ⊤))
    (tf : U.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range f) ⟶ Z)
    (tg : U.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range g) ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsPullback tf (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range f)) i e)
    (hg : IsPullback tg (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range g)) i e) :
    P.FrameBoundaryProductsLocallyHEq U (e ≫ v ≫ b) c f g →
    (cupSingle P U).map
        (P.frameClosedCoefficientIso (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range f))
          (pullback.snd i e) hf.isoPullback hf.isoPullback_hom_snd).inv ≫
      P.frameClass b v i c hcodim
        { U := U, e := e, etale := inferInstance, f := f, toZ := tf, isPullback := hf } =
    (cupSingle P U).map
        (P.frameClosedCoefficientIso (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range g))
          (pullback.snd i e) hg.isoPullback hg.isoPullback_hom_snd).inv ≫
      P.frameClass b v i c hcodim
        { U := U, e := e, etale := inferInstance, f := g, toZ := tg, isPullback := hg }
